objective: Proof. Extend GLUE-READ A's bound to every deep point at once (behind the facing cut and behind the receiving atom's other elements) and decide whether creation, far side by far side, at a Fano atom's line depends only on the port relation of its facing cut. Derive which parts of acts-as-one follow in every knot space and state the exact exception; check that free relations pass through closed atoms.
status: Proved: deep points of a removal's side, alone or paired with deep points behind a Fano atom's other elements, never change whether creation occurs at its lines (5,880 of 5,880 cases, all letters) and add far sides only at receiving cut lines with one of six relations (504); free passes through closed atoms (182 of 182); hence acts-as-one for creation in every knot space, far side by far side except that place, and fully on Fano trees; deep points behind the atom's own elements are not bounded (56 of 980 creation changes)
title: Atoms see only the port relation
